## c2c820ee2654

**Finding: the normal generator collapses the dual-legend graph problem into a
shape-only shortcut.**  The canonical task uses the count of blue legend cells
as graph-cluster size and the count of red legend cells as component degree.
The generator's normal path instead always writes exactly one blue legend cell
and no red cells (`want-cluster=1`, `want-degree=0`).  It then makes the target
the only multi-cell monochromatic body object; every decoy is a differently
colored singleton.  Consequently, “ignore the legend and graph, crop the only
multi-cell body object” fits every normal generated example.

A replayable default witness is `seed=0, sample_index=0`:

```text
1000000000
0000000000
0000550000
0000500000
0000500000
0000500000
0000000000
0000000000
0000000000
7960000000
0000000000
0000000000
```

The shortcut selects the color-5 polyomino, exactly as the authority does under
the constant 1/0 legend.  It disagrees with the intended rule on this exact
legal discriminator:

```text
11122000
00000000
03450000
00000000
00000660
00000660
```

Here the 3-blue/2-red legend requests the middle singleton (color 4) of the
three-object contact chain, so the canonical Racket authority returns:

```text
8
```

The shape-only shortcut instead selects the unrelated 2x2 color-6 object and
would return:

```text
88
88
```

I checked the stated authoritative output by executing the selected canonical
Racket program through `RacketBridge` on the exact grid.  The generator should
vary both legend counts and include distractors that defeat size/shape-only
selection.
